item.title: A Comprehensive History of CSS --- Institutions, Specs, and Practice
item.description: A detailed, timeline-driven history of CSS that connects W3C specifications and browser implementation realities with community practice (from early standards and the browser wars to responsive design, Flexbox, Grid, and modern CSS architecture).

item.title: History of HTML (1990--2025)
item.description: A detailed history of HTML (1990–2025): standards bodies, browser wars, XHTML, HTML5, parsing, semantics, accessibility, and modern web platform practice.
